identifiers.initial is set on the Job form on every run (a killed run that left 'corrected' heals itself); the test reverses the first export, sets identifiers.corrected and exports again. Both are alphanumeric, space-free and neither contains the other or the job name, so a substring search of the file is unambiguous.
The accounting system's rejection happens in Famous, outside PET Web; it is recorded as not-automatable and the corrected identifier is treated as the code it expects.
